title: Triple-input restricted Fourier weight identity
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $F:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $S\subseteq J$. For three independent uniform full sign vectors, the expected triple-input restricted Fourier weight observation equals the restricted Fourier weight of the real-valued sign function associated to $F$ at $J,S$.
hypotheses_covered: Triple of independent uniform full sign vectors
